g.text: Entry : issuer DID, name, allowed docTypes
For support by OS, refer to 5.1 of [mdoc Proximity Presentation]
1. Check that the kid in the issuerAuth signature header is a DID URL
2. Check that the DID of the kid is in the trusted issuer list
3. Check that the docType is in the allowed docTypes
4. Obtain the public key from the stored issuer DID Document
